$comment: BASELINE for check-out-of-tree-generation.ps1, established 2026-08-10 by the first real
out-of-tree generation this repo has ever run (npdev-canary, 807 files scanned, 15 hits).
The gate is a RATCHET, not a clean bill of health. Every entry below is a path pattern whose
absolute-path leak was ALREADY PRESENT when the check was written. A NEW leak anywhere else
fails immediately -- which is the whole point, since eight defects of exactly this family
reached a third party while every gate stayed green.
Two categories, and the difference is the entire honesty of this file:
accepted     -- correct as-is; will never be 'fixed'. Provenance records and comments that
DISCUSS the defect are not instances of it.
known-defect -- a real leak, filed, still present. These are NOT excused. Each names its
ledger item. When one is fixed, DELETE its entry so the ratchet tightens.
Do not add an entry without a reason. An allowlist that states something untrue is worse than
no allowlist (the lesson STOR-13's own allowlist taught this repo).

entries.reason: The match is INSIDE a comment explaining why a hardcoded D:/WorkSpace build-output path must not be used. Prose about the defect is not the defect.
Same shape: a comment recording that this line USED to read the author's drive letter and no longer does. Deleting the comment to satisfy a grep would destroy the record of the fix.
Provenance. Records which workspace produced this run and is already declared non-reproducible by check-deterministic-generation.ps1. Not shipped inside the app.
Provenance, same declared exclusion as generation-run.json. Records the model's source path at build time; nothing resolves it at runtime.

npdev.database.data-root is baked to D:/WorkSpace/NPDev/Build/databases/<app>. This is RESOLVED AT RUNTIME -- a stranger's app tries to open a database on a drive they do not have. The most serious of the fifteen.
Same data-root, restated in the ops plan the user is told to read.
rootModel is an absolute authoring path shipped inside the app's own resources. Provenance belongs in Reports/, not in src/main/resources.
sourceOfTruth.business/database are absolute authoring paths, again shipped inside the app.
